question: Do low-capacity cube-safe explicit operators transfer across held scenes within each one-author camera/film display-chain family?

split.development_rule: all accepted pairs not in confirmation

paired_samples.warp: digital linear-sRGB to film geometry with frozen BO2 homography and OpenCV INTER_LINEAR
paired_samples.sampling: row-major evenly spaced over eligible pixels

family_curve_positive_matrix.family: three-segment endpoint-fixed monotone curves then positive row-stochastic matrix

evaluation.primary_metric: per-scene linear-sRGB RGB RMSE on frozen registered low-gradient pixels
evaluation.selection: lowest parameter count among eligible candidates; ties use lower mean RMSE

branches.candidate_pass: freeze the selected operator family and fit on all development scenes before one untouched confirmation run
branches.all_candidates_fail: close this low-capacity family without threshold or capacity rescue; retain paired data for another preregistered mechanism
branches.confirmation_later_fails: close without refitting or selecting from confirmation

forbidden: change splits, masks, samples, operators, fit settings or gates after formal execution
call a camera-family display-chain result a film-stock response or scanner-independent operator
train a content router or direct-RGB model
claim_ceiling: one-author weak-paired camera/film display-chain operator development evidence; not exact stock, calibrated response, scanner-independent transform, product promotion or commercial-use training
